mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5%), or Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through joint economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, quarterly GDP growth below 1.5% annualized signals economic deceleration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth < 1.5% annualized, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% indicates persistent inflationary pressures that trigger Federal Reserve rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 2.5), or Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above its 3-month moving average indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 3-month MA, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous negative monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points indicate labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS growth < 0 and UNRATE rise > 0.1pp, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate above 2.5% signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
